minutes.summary: With the chairman (Chris) away, the Lunenburg Finance Committee met mainly to compile a list of fiscal policies (free cash, revenue projections, stabilization accounts, capital committee, OPEB/retirement contributions) to review in future meetings and discuss whether to revive a tri-board committee with the Select Board and School Committee. No votes were taken except the procedural adjournment; year-end transfers and department reports were deferred to the next meeting.

budget_items.what_was_said: A member recalled that a capital plan item to add cooling at the primary school lacked enough money, so the School Committee asked to redirect those funds to buy mini-splits, which required Finance Committee and Select Board support.

A member recounted a past request, as Parks Commission chair, to use a revolving fund to increase the recreation director's hours; the Select Board supported it but this committee did not at the time. The Parks Commission has since launched a pilot program along similar lines.
The committee listed policy areas to review going forward: free cash, revenue projections, stabilization accounts, the capital committee's process, and OPEB/retirement fund contributions.

A member noted one stabilization account is for fire trucks, around $2 million, and raised the open question of the policy for when funds should be drawn from stabilization accounts versus only for one-time revenue drops or expenses.
A member said the town changed vacation/overtime and paid-time-off policies to retain employees, which had a financial cost, and that money had to be added to an account this year to cover it.

decisions.decision: Committee will compile and prioritize a list of fiscal policies (free cash, revenue projections, stabilization accounts, capital committee, OPEB) for future review, rather than voting on any now.
No consensus reached on reviving a tri-board committee this meeting; the matter is left for Chair Chris to take the lead on when he returns.
Election of a new vice chair (the prior one was lost) will wait until Chair Chris returns, likely discussed at a future meeting rather than July 9th.
Committee will ask Chris about possibly moving the date of the reorg/election meeting so a member unavailable on July 9th can attend.
Year-end transfers are not yet ready and are deferred to a future meeting.
